ordering.major: example_id in the frozen dataset order

row_semantics.accepted: One nonempty answer, a 64-character prompt hash, null failure fields and only one-shot call records.
row_semantics.method_execution_failed: Empty answer, no prompt hash, a nonempty error, and every available failed call record; remains in the denominator.
row_semantics.protocol_blocked: Exactly reflection_memory or cmi, no endpoint calls, explicit ProtocolBlockedGoldLeak, and one row for every example and seed.

next_gate: After WMA release, bind exact implementation hashes and the 87-ID order into a separately frozen synthetic lifecycle package before any real model call.
authorization: Synthetic temporary-directory tests only. This proposal authorizes no server root, real endpoint, dataset execution, scoring, table admission, SOTA claim, archive deletion, or model cleanup.
